description: Oscillator built on a Rosenberg model of the glottal pulse, with a noise component for breath.

params.text: Sets the pitch, four and a half octaves either side of C4 at 261.63Hz.
Sets how much of each cycle the pulse spends opening, from 1% to 100%; the remainder of the open phase is the closing curve.
Sets how much of each cycle the pulse stays shut at zero, from 0% to 90%.
Mixes gaussian noise into the wave, shaped by a raised cosine over each cycle, from none to 90%.
Sets how far the FM input shifts the frequency, up to 1000Hz per volt at full.
Scales the CV for the setting it belongs to, from -100% to +100%.
Toggles a 2000Hz lowpass on the output, which rounds the wave off.

inputs.text: Pitch at a volt per octave, added to the frequency knob.
Shifts the frequency in Hz rather than by octave, scaled by the small knob for it.
Moves the setting it belongs to, scaled by the attenuverter for that setting.
A voltage here toggles the de-emphasis filter.

outputs.text: The glottal wave with the noise mixed in, swinging between -5V and 5V.

inputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
